api_token.label: API Token
api_token.description: The API Token/Key of your Pushover application, under Your Applications at pushover.net.

cancel_emergency_retries.label: Cancel Emergency Retries
cancel_emergency_retries.description: Stop the retry loop of one emergency notification receipt

receipt.label: Receipt
receipt.description: Receipt id returned by Send Push Message at emergency priority (2).

cancel_emergency_retries_by_tag.label: Cancel Emergency Retries by Tag
cancel_emergency_retries_by_tag.description: Stop the retry loops of every emergency notification carrying a tag

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: A single tag that was supplied in the Tags parameter at send time, for example deploy. One tag only, with no spaces or slashes.

rename_delivery_group.label: Rename Delivery Group
rename_delivery_group.description: Change the name of a Pushover delivery group

group_key.label: Group Key
group_key.description: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.

name.label: New Name
name.description: The new group name, for example Weekend On-Call.

add_user_to_group.label: Add User to Delivery Group
add_user_to_group.description: Add a user key as a member of a Pushover delivery group

group_key.label: Group Key
group_key.description: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.

user.label: User Key
user.description: The 30-character user key of the person to add.

device.label: Device
device.description: Limit group deliveries to this one device of the user. All of their devices receive them when omitted.

memo.label: Memo
memo.description: Note stored with the membership, maximum 200 characters, for example Primary on-call.

remove_user_from_group.label: Remove User from Delivery Group
remove_user_from_group.description: Permanently remove a member from a Pushover delivery group

group_key.label: Group Key
group_key.description: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.

user.label: User Key
user.description: The 30-character user key of the member to remove. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.

disable_group_user.label: Disable Group User
disable_group_user.description: Temporarily stop a group member from receiving group messages

group_key.label: Group Key
group_key.description: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.

user.label: User Key
user.description: The 30-character user key of the member to suspend. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.

enable_group_user.label: Enable Group User
enable_group_user.description: Resume group deliveries to a suspended group member

group_key.label: Group Key
group_key.description: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.

user.label: User Key
user.description: The 30-character user key of the suspended member. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.

assign_license.label: Assign License
assign_license.description: Spend a prepaid credit to license a Pushover user

user.label: User Key
user.description: The 30-character user key to license. Supply either this or Email, not both.

email.label: Email
email.description: Pushover account email of the person to license, used when their user key is unknown. Supply either this or User Key, not both.

os.label: Operating System
os.description: Restrict the license to one platform. Any platform may be used when omitted.

assign_license.beforeRequest: if (!inputs.user === !inputs.email) throw new Error('Assign License needs exactly one of User Key or Email to identify the recipient.'); return request;
